why_informative: Phase 3A: base 1.5B exact-output accuracy with the fixed implementation shown (A4) is 0.331 < 0.5 - execution reasoning is limited even with full specification; whether scale relieves it is the open capacity question (H3)
levels_and_schema: identical to Phase 3A: A0, A3, A4 with the bare prefill 'assert <call> == ', and the A0 answer-schema control; greedy; max_new_tokens 48/96

arms.base_1_5b: reused unchanged from Phase 3A (generations sha256 e41bdf29...)
arms.qwen7b_base: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct @ c03e6d358207e414f1eca0bb1891e29f1db0e242 (local snapshot, 4 shards, 15 GB; pinned in config.IMMUTABLE_MODEL_REVISIONS; no download), 4-bit NF4, sdpa, same chat template and system prompt

not_run_in_phase3: higher-rank adapter or full fine-tuning (a Phase 4 capacity arm, if selected)
runner: python scripts/gpu_run.py start --name phase3c_capacity -- .venv-gpu/Scripts/python.exe scripts/run_fixed_input_probe.py --arms qwen7b_base --out results/sft_root_cause/phase3c

gate.name: answer-rate non-inferiority (required before any accuracy is interpreted)
gate.rule: 7B answer rate >= (1.5B base answer rate - 2 points) at each of A0, A3, A4, and 7B strict 'ANSWER:' rate >= 0.95 on the control; otherwise no capacity conclusion is drawn
gate.reason: an earlier 7B experiment suffered an answer-contract collapse; a larger model that emits nonanswers does not establish a capacity result

primary_contrasts.C1: A4 exact-output accuracy, 7B minus 1.5B base (execution reasoning with the fixed code shown)
primary_contrasts.C2: A0 exact-output accuracy, 7B minus 1.5B base (value prediction from production information)

secondary: 7B minus arm A 431 at A0 and A4

inference.method: paired cluster bootstrap over semantic group

decision_rules.C1_lower_bound_ge_5: H3 supported at model scale: 1.5B execution reasoning is capacity-limited
decision_rules.C1_not_improved: H3 weakened: scaling to 7B does not relieve the execution-reasoning ceiling
decision_rules.C2: reported with the same regions; if C1 improves but C2 does not, A0 information (specification) is the binding limit at 7B

limitations: 7B vs 1.5B differs in pretraining data and recipe as well as parameters: this is a scale contrast, not a pure capacity manipulation
does not test LoRA rank or full fine-tuning
